headline: Sr. Fullstack Engineer | Accessibility Program Owner

bullets.text: Built across the stack on real-time teacher dashboards surfacing AI insights and safety violations from 17k+ daily student messages.
Closed 480 WCAG 2.1 issues across 6 teams in Q1 2026 as Accessibility Program Owner, leading auditing, training, tracking, and driving the effort towards our first VPAT.
Architected Sentinel, an AI-augmented accessibility audit harness combining deterministic tooling with LLM judgment for interpretive WCAG criteria, enabling on-demand audits.
Produced internal accessibility curriculum, including hands-on training workshops.
Technical lead for new-user onboarding experiences which increased 7-day activation rates by 7% and had a 2X result on feature adoption.

Developed React frontend for Lucid's integration marketplace, increasing partner integration visibility and resulting in 14 new partner-built integrations and 540,000+ installs in the first year post-launch.
Leveraged low-level TypeScript compiler APIs to automate GraphQL schema → TypeScript type generation, eliminating a manual process and improving type safety at scale.
Built modular, performant React + TypeScript components aligned to brand standards via Styled Components, contributing to Lucid's internal design system.
Rebuilt canyonsdistrict.org from scratch, a site serving 5 million sessions per year, while reducing average page load times by 20%.
Built a centralized news publishing dashboard enabling district personnel to push content across all school-level sites, replacing a fragmented manual workflow.
Served as technical decision-maker for all web properties across the district, owning architecture, tooling selection, and delivery standards.
Integrated custom event tracking via Google Tag Manager to analyze user engagement, providing data-backed insights that led to a complete homepage redesign.
Produced analytics reports and UX improvement recommendations backed by behavioral data, bridging the gap between engineering and product strategy.
